bio.text: Robert L. Stewart represents District 23 in the Alabama Senate, to which he was elected in November 2022.

According to the Alabama Legislature's profile, he is a native of Selma and earned a B.S. in accounting from Tuskegee University in May 2012 and a master's degree from Kennesaw State University in July 2016.
The profile says he is employed as a tax policy lobbyist for Public Citizen, Inc.
